parties: Sammaan Capital Limited (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance Limited)
headline: Sammaan Capital allots ₹70 crore secured NCDs on private placement basis
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited allotted 7,000 secured, rated, listed, redeemable non-convertible debentures (NCDs) of ₹1 lakh face value each, aggregating ₹70 crore, on a private placement basis. The allotment was approved by the Board on 3 September 2025 and the Securities Issuance and Investment Committee on 23 February 2026.
implication: The private placement NCD issuance by a listed NBFC successor entity (post-rebranding from Indiabulls Housing Finance) demonstrates continued capital-raising flexibility for housing finance entities under Reg 46 of SEBI Listing Regulations, even where equity capital may face headwinds; counsel should note the precedent that Board + SIAC authorization suffices for debenture allotment without fresh shareholder vote.
detail: Sammaan Capital (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance Limited) completed allotment of 7,000 secured, rated, listed, redeemable NCDs of ₹1,00,000 face value each on 26 February 2026, raising ₹70 crore via private placement. The issuance was authorized by Board resolution dated 3 September 2025 and confirmed by the Securities Issuance and Investment Committee on 23 February 2026. As a listed NBFC, the company is subject to SEBI Listing Regulations and RBI NBFC guidelines; the secured nature and listed status provide retail investor access and credit rating validation. The private placement structure allows targeted placement without open offer mechanics.
